_comment: The renderer's bundle budget (issue #101). No specification governs this:
our own design, adopted from the family recipe.
max_gzip_bytes is the ceiling, set from arithmetic over the screens still
to land rather than from today's build, so it does not creep one screen at
a time. max_growth_gzip_bytes is what ONE change may add.
measured_gzip_bytes is what CI last produced on main, and it is the
baseline a pull request is charged against; the baseline is read from the
merge base rather than from the branch, so a change cannot make itself
green by editing a number here.
